# Vedantu

> > Vedantu is an online learning platform offering LIVE K1-K12 classes, competitive exam preparation (JEE/NEET), and comprehensive NCERT study materials for CBSE curriculum.

Vedantu provides personalized 1-on-1 LIVE online classes across multiple subjects and specializations, from foundational skills like phonics and public speaking to advanced exam preparation. The platform serves students from early grades through competitive exams with structured curricula, NCERT solutions, and supplementary educational resources.

## Key Topics

- CBSE
- NCERT Solutions
- Class 12
- Class 11
- JEE Preparation
- NEET Preparation
- Physics
- Chemistry
- Biology
- Mathematics
- LIVE Classes
- Personalized Learning
- Olympiad Prep
- Sample Papers
- Revision Notes

## Core Programs

- [Vedantu: Premier K1 to K12 Online Classes and Offline Centers for Competitive Exams](https://www.vedantu.com): Vedantu homepage: LIVE online K1-K12 classes, JEE/NEET prep, board exams
- [Vedantu English Superstar | Online Reading, Phonics Classes for Kids (LKG–8)](https://www.vedantu.com/english-superstar): English Superstar: 1-on-1 LIVE phonics and reading classes for LKG-8
- [Online Public Speaking Classes for Kids (LKG–8) | Vedantu Superspeakers](https://www.vedantu.com/superspeakers): Vedantu Superspeakers: LIVE spoken English and public speaking for LKG-8
- [Online Math Classes for Kids (KG-8) | 1-on-1 LIVE| Vedantu Super Math](https://www.vedantu.com/supermath): Super Math: 1-on-1 LIVE math classes KG-8 with Olympiad prep

- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 Maths](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-maths): Class 12 Maths NCERT solutions with formulas and sample papers
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 English 2025-26 |Chapter Wise PDF Answers](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-english): Class 12 English NCERT solutions with chapter-wise PDF downloads
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 Accountancy](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-accountancy): Class 12 Accountancy NCERT solutions for CBSE exam prep
- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 Business Studies](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-business-studies): Class 12 Business Studies NCERT solutions with revision notes

- [NCERT Solutions For Class 12 Hindi](https://www.vedantu.com/ncert-solutions/ncert-solutions-class-12-hindi): Class 12 Hindi NCERT solutions for CBSE exam preparation
